metadata.article_title: Power to pronounce judgment written by judge’s predecessor.

article.title: Power to pronounce judgment written by judge’s predecessor.
article.content:
2Power to pronounce judgment written by judge’s predecessor.

Order 20, Rule 2
6[A Judge shall] pronounce a judgment written, but not pronounced, by his predecessor.

6 Subs. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 70 for “A Judge may” (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
